descs.t: President Trump has named Stephen Miller White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles from Monday, days after Republicans lost the midterms. Democrats are already preparing a fight on immigration, the issue Miller is known for. We walk through the change, the reactions on both sides of the aisle and what it means for the White House.
